gaps.title: Challenging Ground Truth Verification in Real News Items
gaps.evidence_snippet: As outlined in the following, the ground-truth remains challenging since we cannot verify with absolute certainty whether all the content of real news items is in fact true.

gaps.title: There is no existing benchmark dataset that includes resources to extract all…

gaps.title: Creating a comprehensive large-scale fake news benchmark dataset
gaps.evidence_snippet: A promising direction is to create a comprehensive and large-scale fake news benchmark dataset, which can be used by researchers to facilitate further research in this area.

gaps.paper_title: Fake News Detection on Social Media: A Data Mining Perspective
gaps.title: Linguistic-based features for fake news have not been fully understood
gaps.evidence_snippet: Note that linguistic-based features have been widely studied for general NLP tasks, such as text classiﬁcation and clustering, and speciﬁc applications such as author identiﬁcation [32] and deception detection [22], but the underlying characteristics of fake news have not been fully understood.
gaps.description: Limitation stated by the authors of "Fake News Detection on Social Media: A Data Mining Perspective" on page 10.
